meta.name: book-to-skill
meta.description: Converts books, documentation folders, and source collections (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, RST, AsciiDoc, RTF, MOBI/AZW) into structured agent skills — extracting named frameworks, principles, techniques, and anti-patterns into a master SKILL.md plus on-demand chapter files, a glossary, a patterns file, and a decision cheatsheet. Use when the user wants to study a document with an agent, apply an author's frameworks while working, turn internal docs or standards into a reusable knowledge base, or package a compiled book skill as a claude-skills plugin.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼书籍文档为 agent 可用的结构化技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用 agent 系统学习书籍或文档,并把其中的方法论沉淀为可复用的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Turn books and documents into structured agent skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to study a book with an agent and turn its methods into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把书籍或文档(PDF、EPUB 等)转换成一套结构化的技能文件:精简的主 SKILL.md、按章节的摘要、术语表、模式清单和决策速查表,并提取其中的框架、原则、技巧和反面模式,而非简单摘要。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 agent 研读某本书或文档、在工作中应用作者的框架,或把编译好的技能打包成 claude-skills 插件等场景时触发。

say.text: 把这本书(路径:xxx.pdf)转换成技能,先生成成本预估。
say.note: 会先做 token 预算评估,等你确认后再生成。

say.text: 只分析这本书的结构,先不生成文件。
say.note: 对应 analyze 模式,输出提取报告。

say.text: 把编译好的技能打包成 claude-skills 插件。
say.note: 会触发插件打包步骤,并检查版权。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude converts books/docs (PDF, EPUB, etc.) into a structured skill: compact SKILL.md, chapter summaries, glossary, patterns, and a cheatsheet—extracting frameworks, principles, techniques, anti-patterns, not summaries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to study a document with an agent, apply an author's frameworks, turn internal docs into a knowledge base, or package a compiled skill as a claude-skills plugin.

say_en.text: Convert this book (path: xxx.pdf) into a skill; first run a cost estimate.
say_en.note: Runs token budget pre-flight and waits for approval.

say_en.text: Only analyze the book's structure; don't generate files yet.
say_en.note: Runs analyze mode and outputs an extraction report.

say_en.text: Package the compiled skill as a claude-skills plugin.
say_en.note: Triggers plugin packaging with a rights check.
